targets.summary: Move the new declaration out of shim_mps.h and into torch/csrc/stable/c/shim.h, with a comment pointing to where the other set_args functions live.
targets.evidence: The comment is anchored at the top of shim_mps.h (`#ifndef AOTI_TORCH_SHIM_MPS`), but it is about the newly added declaration. In the reviewed version, shim_mps.h declared `AOTI_TORCH_EXPORT AOTITorchError aoti_torch_mps_set_arg_bytes(AOTIMetalKernelFunctionHandle func, unsigned idx, const void* ptr, uint64_t size);`. The merged diff deletes that declaration from shim_mps.h entirely, and the other set_arg functions (`aoti_torch_mps_set_arg_tensor`, `aoti_torch_mps_set_arg_int`) are left in place. So the new declaration was taken out of shim_mps.h, as the maintainer asked. The diff only covers shim_mps.h, so it can't confirm that the declaration landed in torch/csrc/stable/c/shim.h or that the requested comment was added there. Still, removing it from this file strongly suggests it was moved as requested.
